Maximum error <= 3.0% on the approved validation set

acceptance_gates.metric: Stale command detection and rejection rate
Fallback activation on timeout or missing output

acceptance_gates.metric: Outputs within configured safe actuator limits
Agreement between transparent reference path and validated implementation

constraints: Operating velocity shall remain within 20–55 m/s.
The system shall reject stale model commands.
The system shall clamp actuator commands to configured safe bounds.
The system shall provide a safe fallback behavior on timeout, invalid input, or model/data unavailability.
The implementation shall preserve a transparent reference path for verification and comparison.
Geometry input shall be accepted in STL format.
Reference geometry shall be compatible with DrivAerML-derived inputs.
No assumption is made about pretrained inference availability or model accuracy beyond measurable validation results.
No board, device, or compute architecture is implied by this contract.

name: intelligent_active_aerodynamics_controller
objective: Develop an intelligent active-aerodynamics control system for automotive operation over 20–55 m/s using a physics-based surrogate and a transparent reference implementation. The system must support model evaluation, architecture partitioning, implementation, optimization, and delivery of hardware, firmware, and software elements with bounded control behavior, stale-data detection, timeout handling, and safe fallback.
required_capabilities: Ingest vehicle geometry and operating-condition inputs.
Evaluate a physics-based surrogate for active-aerodynamics control decisions.
Provide a transparent reference computation path for cross-checking results.
Partition the application into data ingestion, model evaluation, control synthesis, command validation, and safety management functions.
Detect stale data based on age or sequence validity.
Enforce timeout handling for delayed or missing outputs.
Transition to a safe fallback state when validation fails.
Support architecture definition and optimization for the final implementation path.
Expose interfaces suitable for hardware, firmware, and software integration.
